title: Kissed Peppery Indian Peas Lassi
description: A refreshing and adventurous Indian drink featuring caramelized peas and a hint of peppery flavor, perfect for warm days. This dairy-free friendly lassi is a unique twist on traditional Indian beverages.
instructions: In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat and caramelize the peas for 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger, black pepper, cumin seeds, and salt to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
In a blender, combine the caramelized pea mixture, coconut milk, water, and lemon juice.
Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy.
Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a large bowl.
Add the honey to the mixture and stir well, if using.
Chill the lassi in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Serve the lassi cold, garnished with a sprinkle of black pepper and a few fresh peas.
Enjoy your refreshing and unique Kissed Peppery Indian Peas Lassi.
